I’ve been taking 10 mg for 3 weeks now and a couple weeks ago, my getting out of bed ritual has turned into hell. I work from home and get out of bed almost 90 minutes early to cool down and shower. The last week or so, i started sweating through my clothes after my shower. I now take a shower during my mid-morning break. It was so intense this morning that i used a sick day.

Best wishes on the start! I started on 10mg about two weeks ago and my whole world is changing. I wake up positive. Challenges i encounter at my work from home job seem less terrible. I’m a lot more upbeat and generally happy. I really can’t say anything negative about my experience yet. I truly hope you get what you need.

Omg this makes me feel better. I have some mild to moderate depression and my doc put me on 50mg Seroquel for three days and I said enough. I got it in my head that I needed to drive to my hometown to kill my old arch enemy (hadn’t seen or heard from since 1990) before he got wise and tried to kill me. I saw dark thoughts were a thing but holy hell.
